metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods by midudev: After, a prompt queue; Use Haiku and Think Hard, prompt prefixes for one turn; Token Meter, tokens in the status line

plugins.name: after
plugins.description: Queue prompts to run after the current task, without steering it.

plugins.name: use-haiku
plugins.description: Start a prompt with _ to run that turn on Haiku.

plugins.name: think-hard
plugins.description: Start a prompt with + and that turn thinks at max effort.

plugins.name: token-meter
plugins.description: Shows each turn's tokens in the status line, with the session total.
